output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers_completed_2024_not_2025
FROM marts.fct_orders o
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM marts.fct_orders o2
    WHERE o2.customer_id = o.customer_id
      AND o2.status = 'completed'
      AND o2.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o2.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  );
output.explanation: Counts distinct customers with at least one completed order dated in 2024 who have no completed order dated in 2025. Completed is taken as status = 'completed' on marts.fct_orders, with order_date determining the year. I did not verify the exact status values in the data, so if 'completed' is not the literal status label, the filter needs adjusting.
